narrative.overview: Taskora places dense work on calm paper surfaces inside a graphite frame. Electric lime is a precise signal for selection, primary action, and a few points of attention. The interface stays compact enough for a working board while preserving hierarchy. The personal task map extends this language into a scrollable time plane: cards sit near dates, relationships remain visible, and details open beside their parent. The same visual roles apply in light and dark themes.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite navigation and switchers frame light work surfaces.
One bright lime signal identifies active states and key actions.
Compact cards and explicit connection lines keep relationships legible.
Motion reveals structure without withholding content.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime marks selection and action; it does not fill ordinary content surfaces.

rules.name: The Content First Rule
rules.body: Essential content is visible before entrance animation, so loading or reduced motion never creates an empty work plane.

dos: Do keep Taskora data and primary actions immediately legible on the work plane.
Do pair lime with dark text and retain a visible focus state.
Do use text and line style to distinguish selected, proposed, and contextual states.
Do let the map scroll at phone widths and preserve date meaning across scales.
donts: Don't spread lime across ordinary card backgrounds.
Don't hide content until animation completes.
Don't encode ownership or dependency status through color alone.
